target_customer: Individual athletes and active people paying for a prehab and mobility app
problem: Athletes want injury prevention and rehab programs tailored to sport and history instead of generic exercises.
business_model: Consumer subscription app (Pro tier $8.99 per month or $39.99 per year per a third-party page citing the App Store)
product_category: Consumer fitness and digital physical therapy

founders.name: Albert Jo
previous_startups: Shipped consumer health apps (names not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page says amateur boxer, Army Reserves infantryman and former Uber software engineer.

technical_complexity.rationale: A personalised exercise program generator on iOS is mostly content, rules and LLM prompting for a solo founder.

defensibility.rationale: Programs and an app are easily copied and well funded digital physical therapy firms exist; no data moat is shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large digital MSK players focus on employer benefits, and no action against Adapted was found.

market_need_then: Digital physical therapy was a funded category by 2024, but no evidence of athlete specific demand at founding was gathered.

identity.voice_and_tone: Athlete-focused: bulletproof your body, no generic exercises.

branding.community_and_virality: Reported Product Hunt launch in April 2026 with 127 upvotes, hunted by Garry Tan, per a third-party page.

brand_strength.rationale: Plain word name with an adaptive meaning that fits the product, but limited brand presence beyond directory and Product Hunt listings.

outcome_analysis: Adapted is a two person Winter 2024 company still active, with an iOS app claiming over 1,000 athletes and a 4.6 rating. No funding, acquisition or shutdown was found, so its outcome is unknown. A very small team and low defensibility are the main risks; the App Store listing says it is not a medical device.
notes: Founded year not stated by YC page. Site copyright holder is Get Convey Inc., which may be a legal entity name; not investigated. No funding found anywhere. Sword Health and Hinge coverage found is dated June 2024 or later, after the January 2024 batch start, so no dated competitors are listed.
